Total Assets
As of 31 December 2025 , total assets  was 4,146.2 million, increased by 723.1  million or + 17.4% 
compared to 31 December 2024 , with the key changes as follows:
•Cash and Cash Equivalents: Decreased by 132.3 million, primarily due to pledge of cash as 
collateral for financial institution ’s liability relating to the CPN and RBR WTE power plants, loan 
repayments, construction payments for CPN and RBR WTE power plants, net with the exercise 
of TGE -Warrant 1.
•Restricted Bank Deposits: Increased by 321.1 from cash pledged as collateral as stated above.
•Property, Plant, and Equipment: Increased by 194.0 million, mainly from the net effect of ( i) 
ongoing construction of the RBR WTE power plant, asset acquisitions in the biomass power 
plants, and (ii) depreciation expenses for the period.
•Rights from service concession arrangements : Increased by 270.8 million, driven by 
construction activities at the CPN WTE power plants.Total Liabilities
As of 31 December  2025, total liabilities was 1,035.4 million, increased by 190.0 million or + 22.5 % compared to 
31 December 2024, with key changes as follows:
•Liabilities from Financial Institutions : Increased by Baht 132.0 million from liabilities from construction of 
municipal solid waste power plants, short -term loans for working capital, net with loans repayments.
•Construction payables: Increased by 50.5 million due to the construction of CPN and RBR WTE power plants
As of 31 December   2025, the D/E ratio was 0.33, insignificantly changed from 0.33 as of 31 December 2024, and 
IBD/E ratio was 0. 14, decreased from 0.23 as of 31 December 2024 according to loans repayment.
